headline: Why Quest Diagnostics (DGX) Is Up 8.2% After Raising 2026 Guidance And Boosting Buybacks
summary: Earlier this week, Quest Diagnostics reported second-quarter 2026 results showing sales of US$3,043 million and diluted EPS of US$2.84, and raised its full‑year 2026 revenue guidance to US$11.95–US$12.05 billion and reported EPS to US$9.97–US$10.17. The company also continued its long-running capital return program, repurchasing 522,436 shares for US$100 million in the quarter, which supports earnings per share alongside higher‑value advanced diagnostics and growing test volumes. headline: Quest Diagnostics (DGX) Stock Gets Fair Value Boost After Q2 Beat And Higher Guidance
summary: Quest Diagnostics is back in focus after analysts lifted Fair Value estimates from US$223.44 to US$239.38, a move that has coincided with price targets shifting into the US$245 to US$265 range for more bullish views and into the low US$230s for more cautious ones. These adjustments reflect how analysts are weighing the Q2 beat, higher full year guidance, and ongoing volume and margin debates when refreshing their models.
